headline: Board Change and Q2 Results Could Be A Game Changer For Mettler-Toledo International (MTD)
summary: Mettler-Toledo International Inc. recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing higher sales of US$1,027.31 million and net income of US$232.90 million, while also appointing MISTRAS Group CEO Natalia Shuman to its Board of Directors effective 3 August 2026. Together with Baron Capital’s decision to increase its long-held position after a recent pullback, these developments point to growing institutional engagement and fresh governance expertise focused on technology-enabled services...
